; (shape Name …), (takes Shape [:as name] [sketch]), (gives Shape …) and (ref path [sketch]). Default names, :as, clashes.
(shape NoteSaved (~ A note reached the disk. ~))
(shape Item)
(shape URL)
(shape shell.Intent)
(shape List<Item>)
(shape Élan)
(behavior Feed (gives Item (~ The next item. ~)))
(behavior Other (gives Item))
(behavior Both (implements Feed) (implements Other))
(behavior Echo (implements Feed) (takes Item))
(behavior (Store T) (takes T) (gives T :as get))
(block Notes
  (level
    (block Notes.Editor
      (takes NoteSaved (~ Refresh after a save. ~))
      (gives Item)
      (takes Item :as backlog)
      (takes URL)
      (takes shell.Intent)
      (takes List<Item>)
      (takes Élan)
      (takes Item :as item2 (sketch "Named explicitly."))))
  (level
    (block Notes.Store (implements (Store Item)) (gives NoteSaved) (takes Item :as feed))))
(block Clash
  (takes Item)
  (gives Item)
  (implements Feed))
(block Twice (implements Feed) (implements Other))
(block ViaBoth (implements Both))
(block Bad
  (takes)
  (gives :as x)
  (takes Item extra)
  (takes Item :as x (sketch "a") (sketch "b")))
(block Files
  (ref src/store.ts:40-60 (~ Where save renames the temp file. ~))
  (ref "docs/a note.md#rollout")
  (ref https://example.com/atomic-writes)
  (ref ../outside.txt)
  (ref /etc/passwd)
  (ref)
  (ref :as x)
  (ref a.txt extra))
(shape Doc (ref docs/doc.md))
(behavior Kept (ref src/kept.ts) (gives Doc))
